creditor.name: Pellbrook Bank
creditor.debt: A Beckford Home Furnishings store card. Pellbrook Bank lent the money and owns the debt.
creditor.named_as: The creditor is named as Pellbrook Bank together with "your Beckford card", and the collector explains that the bank owns the card.

payment_plans.payments: Equal monthly payments, each rounded down to the cent; the last payment takes the remainder so the plan totals exactly what it covers.

requires: a hardship the consumer has described in their own words
a hardship the consumer has described in their own words
a hardship the consumer has described in their own words
a supervisor's OK, requested before the discount is mentioned

offer_rules: Offers come in this order: the full balance, then payment plans from shortest to longest, then discounts from smallest to largest, then a person.
No discount is more than 40% off.
Where a discount needs a supervisor's OK, the OK is requested before the discount is mentioned.
The collector never hints that a better deal may exist. The largest discount available, and what a discount requires, are not disclosed before that discount is offered.
creditor_rules: A consumer who says the furniture never arrived, came damaged or was returned (12 CFR 1026.12(c)(1)), that the card was supposed to be 0% interest, or that a payment-protection plan on the card should have paid it has a dispute (manual 10.1); after it is recorded, the call goes to a person.
The collector never says the store will take the furniture back, or that the interest will be removed.
